prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
INPUTS: Image 1 is the plain overhead rocky floor to edit. Preserve its ground colors, scale, texture and clear center. Image 2 is a STRICT STYLE REFERENCE for the added edge decoration: thick, confident, near-black plum outlines; clean rounded cartoon shapes; broad simple cel shading. Do not copy the gate or bars from image 2.
Create the finished 1536 x 2048 portrait game background by adding SPARSE, DISTINCT, ASYMMETRICAL details ONLY at the left and right edges of image 1. Strong cartoon line art is essential: the side stones need smooth solid deep plum contours about 12–16px thick at 1536px width, rounded joins and very simple flat 2–3 tone gray/taupe fills. This should look drawn by the same artist as the chunky reference game icon. No fine sketchy lines, faded outlines, gritty texture or realistic shading on the decoration.
COMPOSITION: Only TWO main decorative features, deliberately unlike each other. On the left edge, in the upper-middle third (about 28–43% down), one long, low, irregular angular bedrock slab with a broad flat top, one simple break and a little muted olive moss in just one corner; much of this slab naturally exits the left canvas edge. On the right edge, considerably LOWER (about 58–72% down), one compact loose grouping of two rounded flattened stones of noticeably different sizes, separated by a small gap, plus one tiny pebble. The left feature is angular and elongated; the right feature is rounded and compact. Add at most two isolated small outlined pebbles elsewhere near an edge, not a third slab cluster. No decorative cluster in every corner. No regular vertical spacing. No mirrored silhouettes, duplicate moss-and-slab arrangements, alternating border rhythm, repeated motifs, three-per-side layouts or continuous enclosing frame. Leave long stretches of empty edges. Keep the center 72% of the canvas completely free of these new objects.
VIEW: Strictly top-down, flat ground on one plane, no horizon, cave walls, tall rocks, cliff, raised platforms, pits or landscape perspective. Keep the background ground pale, quiet and identical in palette to image 1 so the separate battle board will still blend into it. Broad dark outlines belong on the few edge decorations, not on every patch or fleck of ground. No board, grid, purple divider, UI, letters, symbols, creatures, props or dramatic lighting. Output only this single full-bleed background.
